name: same-sentence
why: Transient vs durable in one sentence. The first AUTO_FACT_PROMPT extracted 'Nadia is visiting at the end of summer' out of 'Nadia is a paramedic in Leeds and is visiting at the end of summer'. The durable half must be kept as a fact and the scheduled half must not be. Theo is the same shape (moving next spring / pastry chef). The assistant pipeline's version of this fixture is its noisiest — expect variance.

messages: My sister Nadia is a paramedic in Leeds and is visiting at the end of summer, so you'll finally meet her.
*Mira beams.* "A paramedic! I'll have to be on my best behaviour."
And my brother Theo, who's moving to Lisbon next spring, is a pastry chef. He'll bring a mountain of custard tarts when he comes.
"Now that is a brother worth having."
Ha. Also, I don't drive — never learned. Nadia teases me about it constantly.

expect.label: Theo is a pastry chef (fact or summary)

forbid.label: scheduled half stored as a fact
